description: Make an upload link for a finished video file the user has (MP4 or MOV, up to 1 GB), to post with schedule_post mediaId. Returns media_id, upload_url (one hour) and the curl command that sends the file. Does not post.

bytes.description: The file size in bytes, up to 1 GB.

file_name.description: The file name, for the user.

name: upload_for_post

outputSchema.description: Clypmint upload_for_post result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Upload a video to post
